create_event_storage: create an EventStorage context to record training scalars, images, and histograms during iterations
write_json_metrics: write training metrics from EventStorage to a JSON file using JSONWriter with median smoothing
write_tensorboard_logs: write scalars, images, and histograms from EventStorage to TensorBoard using TensorboardXWriter
print_common_metrics: print iteration time, ETA, losses, learning rate, and memory to the terminal using CommonMetricPrinter
get_current_storage: get the currently active EventStorage instance from the thread-local storage stack
